Part II Analysis: Disposition

Data Sample:

  • Juvenile intake complaints with intake dates from July 1, 2015 - June 30, 2021

  • Dispositions – all dispositions for the intake complaints in the sample.

Research Question:

Conduct a front-end system assessment from intake through petition for all complaints 2016-2021.

Methods:

We will conduct a descriptive analysis of the front end of the system from intake through petition, provide unadjusted counts, RRI’s and means tests where applicable, by race, sex, offense, risk, CSU, and year for:

  • Complaints

  • Intake decisions: divert, resolve, petition, other

  • Average LOS on diversion

  • Diversion completions: successful, unsuccessful, other

  • Dispositions on petitioned cases

Cohort: All complaints from 2016-2021



NOTE: Because dispositions file is still duplicated (one complaint may have multiple associated dispositions), percentages will not add up to 100 – we need to create ranking of disposition severity and de-duplicate this file by selecting the most serious disposition associated with a complaint as a next step.

Business rules to discuss:

  • For disposition file cleaning/analysis, should I first filter on intake complaint==petitioned, then merge to dispositions file? We would need to expand current definition of petitioned to include unsuccessful diversions that were eventually petitioned, right?
